status: structural contract; generated poses and physical grips require separate validation
anatomy_priority: User instruction: natural anatomy and a convincing grip on native models take priority over literal Dark Messiah bone or finger-pose matching. Preserve attack/regrip timing and gesture roles; adapt native joint bends, opposition and grip placement as needed

rules.palm_pivot: Source Hand origin, supported by animation hierarchy and dominant palm skin weights; Wrist is a twist helper, not the palm flexion pivot
rules.forearm: Source Elbow/Forearm/Wrist/Hand are collapsed into the native Forearm-to-Hand segment; Wrist world orientation is a distal pronation guide, never a separate native palm pivot
rules.palm_frame: A fixed bind/reference Hand skin-patch basis defines rigid palm orientation in each rig. Hand-to-mean(index,middle,ring,little MCP) and index-to-little MCP define a useful reference frame only at that reference pose; animated MCP-root translations are separate metacarpal deformation, not extra rigid Hand rotation
rules.native_arm_frame: Signed native rest bend-plane basis and real child translation axes; must round-trip oriented native rest, not only joint centres
rules.digit: Source joints 1..4 define three landmark segments for native joints 0..2, preserving native lengths. Source joint 4 also has skin weights: its local animation must be audited before folding this extra control into three target joints. Full axial frame and actual skin pad/nail orientation are separate from segment direction
rules.thumb_homology: The chain is a structural correspondence, not a proven CMC/MCP/IP equivalence. In Staff idle Source Thumb1 lies at about 0.27 palm length, native Finger0 at about 0.71; native opposition must account for different joint locations and actual skin
rules.item: Explicit model attachment plus item animated-root/bind compensation and native physical grip; held-item transform is not a substitute for anatomical palm orientation
rules.native_contact_adaptation: A separately recorded, mesh-specific native anatomical profile may adapt finger bends, abduction, opposition, palm placement, arm position and item orientation. Natural anatomy and convincing finite-handle enclosure take priority over literal Source pose matching; preserve gesture/release roles and event timing, check actual skinned meshes and visually review
rules.left_item: Actual OpenMW left-item mirror is applied once after the bone transform; it does not define or mirror the anatomical palm frame
rules.release: An open Source hand may leave the item; never force contact for every pose
rules.acceptance: Structural mapping, oriented-rest roundtrip, source pose fidelity, actual rendered geometry and visual review are separate checks; none implies the others
